scope: Eight bounded development production mutations, not complete packet qualification or formal/native/performance evidence.
baseline_requirement: Exact 1172-test pass, exit zero, unchanged full source map, closed child and empty owned process group, valid raw UTC/boot/monotonic record.
execution_policy: Primary applies one declared mutation using apply_patch, executes the exact selected behavioral test through the pinned runner with the baseline predecessor, validates the closed child and intended final assertion, then restores only its owned mutation using apply_patch and checks the entire baseline map before the next case.
restoration_scope: The checker restored mode proves source equality only. Primary must separately observe child/process-group closure before restoration; unknown or live child state does not authorize a source rewrite.
rejected_history: Preserve any compile failure, unexpected oracle, timeout or failed restoration without accepting it as the intended behavioral negative. Do not overwrite run artifacts or either earlier checker version.
